operating_notes.text: Acquired 79-bed cancer care hospital in Indore for ₹30 Cr with FY25 turnover of ₹1.99 Cr.
Network operational bed capacity was 3,737 after adding 72 beds in Q1FY27 (51 Noida, 21 Lucknow).
Announced expansion pipeline represents nearly 3,350 additional beds.
International patient revenue grew 23% YoY to ₹78.2 Cr; OPD pharmacy revenue grew 51% to ₹60.9 Cr.

Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,159.05 Cr (+24.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹143.99 Cr (+42.0% YoY).
Global Health reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹1,159.05 Cr and net profit of ₹141.7 Cr.
Global Health Limited’s **Rahul Ranjan** shared the audio recording link for the Q4 FY2026 earnings conference call held May 15, 2026, at 2:00 PM (IST) via ICICI Securities.
Global Health reported Q4FY26 consolidated total income of ₹1,196 Cr (+25% YoY) and net profit of ₹141.7 Cr (+40% YoY).
